name: m4-lazydepth-sam-forks

variantDescriptions.current: `claude/lazy-lub-depth` (retronym/scala#245): by-name `=> Depth`, memoized with local vars in `solve` and `mergePrefixAndArgs`
variantDescriptions.polish: `claude/lazy-lub-depth-polish` (retronym/scala#246): `LazyDepth` abstract class, call sites SAM-convert `() => lubDepth(...)`

description: Is #246's SAM `LazyDepth` perf-neutral against #245's by-name memo? The two builds emit byte-identical class files. One-fork kperf spikes on the laptop disagreed (flat, then +3% cycles and +2.5% alloc for #246), and a paired run on the laptop never got a quiet fork, so: separate forks per build, 6 rounds alternating, typer only, scala corpus, 40 + 30 single shots, M4.
